SERVICES · JUL 2025 – JUN 2026 · REGISTRATION
Key Functionalities on the GST Portal
◆ Simplified Registration Scheme (Rule 14A) — introduction of a simplified GST registration scheme granting registration within 3 working days,
subject to prescribed conditions, to reduce procedural compliance and improveease of doing business forsmall taxpayers.
◆ Opt-outvia FormGST REG-32— enabled filing of FormGST REG-32 to opt out fromregistration obtained under Rule 14A.
◆ Contextual Tooltips in Form GST REG-01 — introduced for each option under the ‘Reason to Obtain Registration’ dropdown, helping applicants make
informed and accurate selections while filing.
◆ Enhanced GSK Appointment Booking System — an updated and improved biometric authentication appointmentsystem introduced for a better user
experience and streamlined appointment management.
◆ Online Declarationfor SpecifiedPremises — made available to both existing taxpayers and applicants seeking new registration.
